mv_filter.comment: Comparisons of a multi-value column to a value. As in the single-stage engine, = and IN match a row if any value matches, <> and NOT IN if no value matches. They are only supported in filters pushed down to the leaf stage.

queries.description: Equality on a STRING MV column
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE tags = 'urgent' ORDER BY order_id

queries.description: Equality with the value on the left side
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE 'vip' = tags ORDER BY order_id

queries.description: IN on a STRING MV column
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE tags IN ('vip', 'normal') ORDER BY order_id

queries.description: IN with a large value list on a STRING MV column
Two equalities on the same MV column are not folded to false
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE tags = 'urgent' AND tags = 'vip' ORDER BY order_id

queries.description: Equality and IN on an INT MV column
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE codes = 5 OR codes IN (1, 3) ORDER BY order_id

queries.description: MV equality pushed below a join
queries.sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.name FROM {orders} o JOIN {customers} c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.tags = 'urgent' ORDER BY o.order_id

queries.description: MV IN pushed below a join with an aggregate above it
queries.sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM {orders} o JOIN {customers} c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.tags IN ('vip', 'normal') GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name

queries.description: Not-equals on an MV column matches rows with no equal value
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE tags <> 'urgent' ORDER BY order_id

queries.description: NOT of an MV equality is the complement
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE NOT (tags = 'urgent') ORDER BY order_id

queries.description: NOT IN on an MV column matches rows with no value in the list
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE tags NOT IN ('urgent', 'normal') ORDER BY order_id

queries.description: NOT of an equality on an INT MV column
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE NOT (codes = 5) ORDER BY order_id

queries.description: String value compared to an INT MV column
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE codes = '5' ORDER BY order_id

queries.description: MV equality in a LEFT JOIN condition is pushed to the leaf stage
queries.sql: SELECT c.name, o.order_id FROM {customers} c LEFT JOIN {orders} o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id AND o.tags = 'vip' ORDER BY c.name

queries.description: MV equality in an aggregate FILTER clause
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tags = 'urgent') FROM {orders}

queries.description: Range comparison on an MV column is not supported
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE NOT (codes > 4)
queries.expectedException: .*Cannot apply '>' to arguments of type '<INTEGER ARRAY> > <INTEGER>'.*

queries.description: Range comparison on a STRING MV column is not supported
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE tags > 'u'
queries.expectedException: .*Cannot apply '>' to arguments of type '<VARCHAR ARRAY> > <CHAR\(1\)>'.*

queries.description: Value that needs a cast of the MV column is not supported
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE tags = 5
queries.expectedException: .*Cannot apply '=' to arguments of type '<VARCHAR ARRAY> = <INTEGER>'.*

queries.description: NULL in an IN list on an MV column is rejected
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM {orders} WHERE tags IN ('vip', NULL)
queries.expectedException: .*NULL is not supported in an IN list compared to multi-value column.*

queries.description: MV filter that cannot be pushed to the leaf stage
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM (SELECT order_id, tags FROM {orders} ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 10) t WHERE t.tags = 'urgent'
queries.expectedException: .*Comparing a multi-value column to a value.*FILTER Intermediate Stage.*arrayContainsString.*

queries.description: MV filter in a disjunction across both sides of a join
queries.sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM {orders} o JOIN {customers} c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.tags IN ('vip', 'normal') OR c.name = 'Alice'
queries.expectedException: .*Comparing a multi-value column to a value.*arrayContainsString.*

queries.description: MV comparison in a projection
queries.sql: SELECT order_id, CASE WHEN tags = 'urgent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM {orders}
queries.expectedException: .*Comparing a multi-value column to a value.*PROJECT Leaf Stage.*arrayContainsString.*

queries.description: arrayContainsString works where an MV comparison is not supported
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM (SELECT order_id, tags FROM {orders} ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 10) t WHERE arrayContainsString(t.tags, 'urgent') ORDER BY order_id
